units.title: 四级选词：日晷上的影子与钟表时间
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: A Shadow across the Dial
materials.text:
A museum explained its sundial using a model and a sequence of photographs. A narrow piece of metal cast a ____1____, the darker region where it blocked direct sunlight. That region was ____2____ onto a marked surface: its position became visible on the receiving face rather than inside the metal itself.

The model’s pointer was aligned with Earth’s rotational ____3____, the imaginary line around which the planet turns. It was ____4____ rather than lying flat. The appropriate angle depended on ____5____, the location’s angular distance north or south of the equator. A design suited to one such position could not simply be moved anywhere without checking its arrangement.

The demonstration also named ____6____, the east–west position relevant when comparing local solar time with a shared clock system. Two places using the same official clock could differ in this geographical respect. The display did not claim that identical clock readings meant their shadows must coincide.

Solar ____7____ was described as the time of the Sun’s daily passage across the local meridian, not automatically twelve on every civil clock. The relationship between the two time descriptions could require an ____8____, a correction rather than a new physical movement of the pointer.

The record noted ____9____ variation through the year, associated with the changing season. On a ____10____ day, with the sky covered and direct sunlight unavailable, the sharp shadow needed for the display might disappear. That absence did not mean the museum’s clock had stopped. The photographs supplied the evidence for the lesson; visitors were not asked to look directly at the Sun.

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: blocked light darker region定义shadow影子。orbit轨道、axis轴线、calendar日历不指光被挡的暗区。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: onto surface且position made visible为projected投到。tilted倾斜不表影投表面，horizontal形容方向，adjustment名词不合。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: imaginary rotational line定义axis自转轴。orbit绕行轨道不是自转中心线，equator赤道为圈，compass仪器不同。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: not lying flat且angle安排指tilted倾斜。projected投影不说明金属姿态，horizontal水平与rather than flat对照不合。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: north south angular distance定义latitude纬度。longitude东西经度下段对照，equator赤道是参照圈非角距离。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: east west position定义longitude经度。latitude南北异，axis轴、calendar历法不指该坐标。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: daily passage local meridian定义solar noon太阳正午。calendar为日期系统、orbit轨道、equator纬圈均非每日时刻名。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: a correction直接释adjustment调整。calendar虽时间工具不指此修正，compass方向仪不作clock correction。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: through year changing season定义seasonal季节的。cloudy阴天不描述年周期，horizontal水平方向，其他词词性或义不合。

questions.prompt: A Shadow across the Dial: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: sky covered direct light unavailable定义cloudy多云的。seasonal季节性不保证遮光，horizontal水平、tilted倾斜不描述天况。

units.title: 四级选词：相机白平衡与现场光线
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The White Card Looked Blue
materials.text:
A photography class compared pictures of a white card under two lamps. One picture had a blue ____1____, an overall colour tint rather than a blue mark painted on the card. The card was ____2____ by the lamp, receiving its light, and could ____3____ part of that light towards the camera.

The camera’s ____4____ recorded incoming light as a signal. The tutor separated what happened at this device from the later interpretation that made an image appear on a screen. A white object did not guarantee an identical recorded signal under every light source.

A known ____5____ object, lacking a strong colour of its own for this task, provided a ____6____ against which the colour treatment could be judged. The class did not assume that any pale object would serve equally well. Its surface and the illumination still mattered.

In ____7____ mode, the camera estimated a treatment without the student entering a fixed choice for each picture. A daylight ____8____ instead used a prearranged setting. Neither label promised that mixed lamps in every room would be represented exactly as the photographer intended.

The students kept ____9____, the amount of light admitted during recording, separate from the decision about colour balance. Increasing that amount was not a general cure for a blue tint. They also checked for ____10____ highlights, areas whose recorded values had reached a limit and lost distinctions. A later colour change could not necessarily recover information never retained in those areas. The lesson compared defined image operations rather than claiming that one attractive result was a uniquely faithful view of the scene.

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: overall colour tint直接定义cast偏色。contrast明暗反差、saturation饱和度不是整体蓝色偏向名词，其他不合。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: receiving lamp light为illuminated被照亮。cropped裁切、clipped截顶说图像操作不表卡受光；neutral为色性质非照明事件。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: light towards camera需原形reflect反射。cast可投射但卡在此返入射光而非投自身光，其他候选无此动作。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: device records incoming light signal定义sensor传感器。reference参照、preset预置非接光器件，exposure过程非器件。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: lacking strong colour own定义neutral中性的。warm暖色是特定色偏，automatic自动为模式，brightness名词不合。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: against which judged定义reference参照。sensor器件、preset设置可有关但不命名已知对象的比较角色，其他义不合。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: estimates without fixed student choice定义automatic自动。preset已设选择下句对照，neutral中性不表决策模式。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: prearranged setting定义preset预置。exposure光量、contrast反差、reference参照不指daylight固定模式。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: amount light admitted recording定义exposure曝光。brightness成像明亮感非入射记录量，saturation为颜色强度，其他不合。

questions.prompt: The White Card Looked Blue: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: values reached limit lost distinctions定义clipped截顶的。cropped裁掉画面边界非强光值到极限，warm暖不表信息截失。

units.title: 四级选词：泥坯干燥中的水分与收缩
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln
materials.text:
A pottery tutor displayed samples from several stages of making a vessel. Fresh clay was ____1____, meaning it could be shaped under pressure without immediately breaking in the conditions shown. This use of the word described a material property, not a claim that clay was a synthetic household polymer.

The clay contained ____2____, water held within the body. During ____3____, liquid water escaped into the surrounding air as vapour. The pot could then undergo ____4____, becoming smaller as part of the drying process. The tutor did not describe a disappearing wet weight as proof that an equal mass of clay solids had vanished.

Wall ____5____ was measured as the distance between the inner and outer surfaces. A very heavy base and thin rim could dry differently. The class aimed for a sufficiently ____6____ distribution of remaining water across the relevant parts, rather than calling a pot ready because one exposed edge felt dry.

Two pieces were ____7____ to make one form. Their connection needed attention as the parts changed. Unwanted ____8____, narrow breaks in the body, might appear if stresses exceeded what the material could bear.

The ____9____ was the heated chamber used for firing. A sample labelled ____10____ had undergone that heating process; it was not merely a freshly shaped object left in the room. The examples helped learners distinguish stages and properties. The lesson supplied no firing schedule and did not imply that every clay body, vessel shape or studio required identical treatment. Students used the displayed history before deciding what a surface appearance could tell them.

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: shape under pressure without immediate break为plastic可塑。porous多孔、dry干不命名受压成形性；glaze釉名不合。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: water within body定义moisture水分。slip泥浆是材料混合而非水分通称，glaze釉、leather皮革不合。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: liquid to surrounding vapour定义evaporation蒸发。shrinkage缩小结果不指气化过程，其他词义不合。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: becoming smaller defines shrinkage收缩。evaporation水相变不等坯尺寸减，thickness为一个尺寸非缩小过程。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: distance inner outer walls定义thickness厚度。moisture含水、slip泥浆不测内外面距，其他义不合。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: remaining water distribution across parts sufficiently same需uniform均匀。dry虽可局部干但不表达各部一致，porous多孔非干燥一致程度。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: two pieces make one form指joined连接。fired烧过非两片接成一体的事件，其他候选不表该动词被动。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: narrow breaks body定义cracks裂纹。glaze釉层、slip泥浆不是断开狭缝，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: heated firing chamber定义kiln窑。glaze材料、leather皮革不是加热室，其他词不指设备。

questions.prompt: Before the Pot Entered the Kiln: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: undergone heating process定义fired烧制过。dry可室内干而非已入窑加热，plastic可塑是前期性质，其他不合。

units.title: 四级选词：等高线地图上的坡度与比例
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Close Lines on the Hill
materials.text:
A geography class examined a fictional walking map before studying a model hill. A ____1____ line connected points of equal height under the map’s convention. The quantity shown was ____2____, height relative to the stated reference level, rather than distance walked along the ground.

The contour ____3____ was the fixed difference in height represented by neighbouring levels in this map. It was not the number of centimetres separating the printed lines. Where those lines crowded together, the ground generally had a steeper ____4____, a greater change in height per unit horizontal distance under the represented conditions.

The map’s ____5____ connected a length on paper with a length on the ground. The class kept ____6____ distance across the level plane separate from ____7____ change upwards or downwards. Neither term alone described the full length of an uneven route.

A ____8____ was the high, extended crest shown on the model, not simply any steep face. The ____9____ was the highest point of the hill. The tutor used both features to show why recognising a shape was more informative than counting lines without their arrangement.

Students consulted the ____10____, the key explaining signs used on this particular map. They did not assume that every unfamiliar mark meant a route was open. The exercise concerned interpretation of a supplied representation. It did not replace current access information or turn a classroom map into permission to travel. The model let students compare the printed relationships with a fully stated landform without needing to visit an actual hill.

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: line equal height定义contour等高线的限定。parallel平行不必同高，magnetic磁性与高度线无关。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: height reference level定义elevation高程。descent下降过程、gradient坡度、terrain地形整体不指该单点高度量。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: fixed height difference adjacent levels为contour interval等高距。scale纸地比例非相邻高度差，orientation朝向不合。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: height per horizontal distance定义gradient坡度。elevation高度本身非变化率，descent下降不保证陡度量，其他不合。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: paper length related ground length定义scale比例尺。legend符号解释非尺度比例，interval已明高度差，其他义不合。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: across level plane定义horizontal水平。vertical上下相反，parallel平行不说明参照平面，magnetic不合。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: change upward downward定义vertical垂直。horizontal水平对照，parallel相互方向不特指上下。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: high extended crest定义ridge山脊。summit顶点非延伸脊，terrain整体非此局部形状，其他不合。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: highest hill point定义summit峰顶。ridge延伸地形而非单一最高点，descent下降不是位置。

questions.prompt: The Close Lines on the Hill: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: key explaining signs定义legend图例。scale量距对应不是符号词典，orientation方向不是说明栏。

units.title: 四级选词：漫画格之间的叙事时间
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Between the Two Panels
materials.text:
A comics workshop placed two images beside each other. Each ____1____ was a separate picture unit in the page. A drawn ____2____ marked its edge. The blank ____3____ between the units separated them visually, but the reader could still connect their events.

In the first image, a person reached towards a door. In the next, the same person stood outside. Readers ____4____ an action between the two views, supplying a connection that had not been pictured in every detail. This did not mean that anything whatsoever could have happened: the surrounding evidence constrained a reasonable interpretation.

The order of units formed a ____5____. A ____6____ from one view to the next could change place, time or viewpoint. The workshop compared a move between moments with two images labelled ____7____, occurring at the same time rather than necessarily one after the other. Page order alone did not always settle story time.

Spoken words appeared inside a ____8____, a shaped area pointing towards the speaker. A separate ____9____ gave written narration outside that speech device. The tutor asked learners to identify the source of a sentence instead of assuming every word belonged to a character’s conversation.

One example was ____10____, presenting no spoken dialogue. It could still show a meaningful exchange through posture and action. The class therefore treated the page as a coordinated arrangement of images, spaces and words, not a prose account broken into decorative boxes. The complete described examples supplied the evidence; no unseen comic strip was needed to answer the questions.

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: separate picture unit page定义panel分格。texture指纹理不指一个图像叙事单元，colour颜色不指图像叙事单元。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: drawn marked edge定义border边界线。gutter格间空隙非画出的边，panel整图不指其线缘。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: blank between units定义gutter格沟。border画线是边，overlap重叠不是留白间隔，其他不合。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: supplying unseen evidence-constrained action定义inferred推知。overlap原形非此过去式，silent形容词不做该及物过去动词，其他不合。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: order units定义sequence序列。dialogue对话、perspective视点、colour颜色不命名排列次序。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: move view next change time place定义transition转换。overlap可能空间交叠非此叙事跨格变化，texture纹理不同。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: same time defines simultaneous同时的。silent无话不表同期，inferred推知不表发生时间关系。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: shaped speech area pointing speaker定义balloon话框。caption叙述框下空对照，dialogue话本身不是载话形状。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: narration outside speech device定义caption叙文。balloon人物说话框异，dialogue对话不等框外叙述，其他不合。

questions.prompt: Between the Two Panels: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: no spoken dialogue定义silent无声的。simultaneous同时不保证无话，colour名词不合，其他词无此意。

units.title: 四级选词：种子离开母株后的不同阶段
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Beyond the Parent Plant
materials.text:
A botany display followed a seed from its parent plant to a new location. ____1____ meant the movement of seeds away from their source. It was distinguished from ____2____, the transfer of pollen involved earlier in the reproductive process. The two events could involve different carriers and happen at different times.

One specimen had light ____3____, thin spreading structures that helped it move through air in the example shown. Another bore ____4____, curved projections that could catch on an animal’s outer covering. A third was ____5____, able to float in the stated conditions. These forms illustrated different transport possibilities, not a rule that every seed with a similar appearance travelled the same distance.

A seed could remain ____6____, alive but not yet growing under the described resting state. If it was still ____7____, it retained the capacity to develop under suitable conditions. A seed reaching a new place did not automatically retain that capacity indefinitely.

____8____ named the start of growth from the seed under appropriate conditions. The developing young plant arose from the ____9____ within it. Later, a seedling described as ____10____ had survived the initial stage and begun sustained growth in its new site.

The class recorded transport, starting growth and later survival separately. Counting arrivals alone could not reveal how many new plants ultimately persisted. The display used stated examples rather than recommending the movement of actual species into unfamiliar environments. Its purpose was to follow a biological sequence while keeping the success claimed at each stage within the evidence available.

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: seeds move away source定义dispersal传播。reproduction生殖范围较广非专离源移动，pollination花粉不同。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: transfer pollen定义pollination传粉。germination种子发芽、dispersal种子移动异，其他不合。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: light thin spreading air structures定义wings翅状结构。hooks弯钩非薄展面，fruit果实不特指种子翅。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: curved projections catching covering定义hooks钩。wings薄翅非钩状突起，offspring后代非形态器官。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: able float defines buoyant有浮力的。waterproof防水不必能浮，attached附着不表水上浮起。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: alive not yet growing resting state定义dormant休眠。viable有发育力不特指休眠，established已稳定生长相反阶段。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: retained capacity develop suitable conditions定义viable有活力。dormant是状态不保证未来容量，waterproof防水非发育能力。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: start seed growth定义germination萌发。reproduction更广不命名这个开始阶段，pollination花粉前过程不同。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: developing young plant inside seed定义embryo胚。fruit果实包裹层非新植物体，offspring后代宽泛且此处within seed具体结构。

questions.prompt: Beyond the Parent Plant: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: survived initial sustained new site growth定义established定植。attached附着未必生存生长，dormant休眠与持续长相反。

units.title: 六级选词：心理量表中的构念与跨组比较
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Same Score in Two Groups
materials.text:
A fictional methods seminar examined a questionnaire intended to assess a psychological ____1____, a theoretical attribute rather than a directly visible physical object. Individual ____2____ were the questions or statements to which participants responded. Their recorded answers were ____3____ data, available in the dataset, while the proposed underlying attribute was treated as ____4____, not measured by one direct reading.

The model included a factor ____5____, a parameter linking an indicator to the underlying dimension. A remaining ____6____ represented the part not accounted for by that relation under the stated model. Calling it remaining did not establish that every omitted influence was meaningless noise. Its interpretation still depended on the assumptions and scope of the model.

The analysts asked about measurement ____7____: whether the relevant measurement relationships held sufficiently alike across the groups being compared. Shared wording alone did not prove this property. A question could have a different role in different contexts even when its printed characters were identical.

They distinguished ____8____, consistency of measurement under specified conditions, from ____9____, the support for a proposed interpretation and use of scores. Repeatedly obtaining a similar answer did not by itself show that the questionnaire measured the intended attribute or supported every decision made with it.

A ____10____ effect occurred when many responses reached the upper limit, restricting visible differences among high-scoring participants. The seminar did not interpret a compressed set of scores as proof that the underlying people were identical. It connected score patterns with the instrument’s range and the particular comparison. The case supplied no actual participant records or claim that one statistical check could certify all uses of a scale.

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: theoretical psychological attribute定义construct构念。correlation变量关系、variance离散量非所测理论属性，其他不合。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: questions statements respond定义items题项。threshold界值、loading参数、bias偏差不命名提问单位。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: recorded available data定义observed可观测的。latent下文不可直接观测，scalar参数约束类别不表已记录。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: underlying not one direct reading定义latent潜在的。observed已显数据相反，scalar不描述隐藏属性，其他词性不合。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: parameter links indicator dimension定义loading载荷。correlation虽可有关联但此处明确测量模型指标-维参数名称，threshold界值非系数。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: part not accounted stated relation定义residual残差。bias系统偏差未必剩余部分全称，variance仅变异数量不命名模型剩余项。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: relationships hold alike across groups定义measurement invariance测量不变性。reliability一致重测非跨组关系约束，validity解释支持非该特定属性。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: consistency measurement specified conditions定义reliability信度。validity解释用途证据非一致本身，correlation关系不等一致性概念。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: support proposed interpretation use定义validity效度。reliability重复一致不足，bias偏差与支持用途概念不同。

questions.prompt: The Same Score in Two Groups: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: many at upper limit defines ceiling天花板效应。threshold效应不是此上界聚集的既定名称，scalar形容参数约束不合。

units.title: 六级选词：蛋白质结构中的序列与构象
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: A Chain and More Than One Shape
materials.text:
A fictional molecular-science exhibit represented a protein as a chain. Its ____1____ was the order of amino-acid units, while individual ____2____ were those units as incorporated into the polymer. The main connected chain formed the ____3____. Side groups contributed further chemical properties without being interchangeable with that central linked structure.

A ____4____ described the spatial arrangement the chain adopted at a particular stage. The exhibit did not present one still image as a claim that every molecule remained rigid in exactly that position. Different arrangements could be accessible under the specified conditions, and the record distinguished a structural description from a film of all possible motions.

The surrounding ____5____ was the dissolving medium, not an empty background without influence. Groups described as ____6____ tended to associate away from water in the context explained by the display. The term was not used to claim that a molecular group made a conscious decision or that all environments imposed the same arrangement.

A protein described as ____7____ had lost important features of its organised structure under the treatment shown. That change did not necessarily mean that its amino-acid chain had been cut into separate units. Structural disruption and chain cleavage were kept distinct.

In another example, molecular ____8____ assisted parts of the folding process without becoming a template that simply dictated every final coordinate. Undesired ____9____ involved molecules clustering together, a different event from one chain reaching its intended organisation.

Finally, a ____10____ constraint concerned rates and the path by which states were reached. It was contrasted with an account concerned only with relative stability at equilibrium. The exhibit therefore kept sequence, environment, spatial arrangement and time-dependent access available as different explanations. Its models supplied all evidence for the language task and did not predict the behaviour of a named real protein.

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: order amino acid units定义sequence序列。conformation空间而非线性次序，mutation变化事件非现有排序。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: incorporated amino acid units定义residues残基。chaperones伴侣为其他分子类，ligand配体不指聚合链单位。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: main connected chain定义backbone主链。sequence排序抽象非化学连接骨架，solvent介质在外，其他不合。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: spatial arrangement chain adopts定义conformation构象。aggregation分子聚集非单链形状，equilibrium平衡状态非空间排列名。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: dissolving medium定义solvent溶剂。ligand结合小体非周遭溶解介质，affinity亲和性质而非媒介。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: groups water-association behaviour defines hydrophobic疏水。native天然态不表该侧基水相倾向，kinetic速率性质异。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: lost organised structure under treatment定义denatured变性。native原态非受损，mutation改变序列不等此不切链结构破坏。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: assist folding molecules定义chaperones分子伴侣。residues为链单位、ligand结合伙伴不泛指辅助折叠机制类。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: molecules clustering defines aggregation聚集。equilibrium可包含多状态非聚成簇事件，conformation为单链构象。

questions.prompt: A Chain and More Than One Shape: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: rates paths constraint定义kinetic动力学的。native原态、hydrophobic疏水不描述状态到达速率，与平衡稳定性区别明确。

units.title: 六级选词：市场出清模型中的价格与剩余
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Price Where Plans Met
materials.text:
A fictional economics tutorial considered a simple market under explicitly stated assumptions. Buyers’ planned purchases at different prices formed ____1____. Sellers’ planned offers formed ____2____. The amount traded was a ____3____, a count of units rather than the price paid for each one. The tutor kept these axes separate when drawing the diagram.

At the model’s ____4____ price, planned purchases and planned offers matched. This description did not assert that every actual market instantaneously reached that point or that the resulting allocation met every social objective. It named a relationship within the supplied model. Actual adjustment and the adequacy of the assumptions required further evidence.

If planned purchases exceeded planned offers at an imposed price, the model showed a ____5____. If offers instead exceeded purchases, it showed a ____6____. Neither term alone identified who obtained the available goods or what happened to unsold units. Those outcomes depended on arrangements the simple intersection did not fully specify.

A price limit described as ____7____ actually constrained the model’s outcome, rather than sitting at a level that left the original result unchanged. When limited units had to be allocated among more interested buyers, ____8____ concerned the method of distributing that restricted availability. A queue was one possible arrangement, not an automatic implication of the word market.

The tutorial also introduced ____9____, a measure of responsiveness expressed relative to changes in another quantity. A curve’s apparent steepness on an arbitrarily rescaled page did not by itself supply this measure.

Finally, tax ____10____ concerned how the burden was distributed, rather than simply which party formally sent money to the authority. The discussion connected the answer with the stated responses of buyers and sellers. It did not treat the person filling out the payment form as the whole economic explanation.

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: buyers planned purchases schedule定义demand需求。quantity单一量而非价量关系，supply卖方不同。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: sellers planned offers定义supply供给。demand买方计划，subsidy补贴为政策不是卖方整套供量关系。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: count units not price定义quantity数量。surplus超额部分非所有交易计数，welfare福利评价不同。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: price matching planned purchases offers定义clearing出清的。inventory是库存而非买卖计划相合的价格属性，imported进口的也不表此关系。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: purchases exceed offers定义shortage短缺。surplus供超需相反，inventory是库存不是买需超卖供的缺口，imported进口非短缺。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: offers exceed purchases定义surplus过剩。shortage反向，inventory库存是持有存量，不等计划供需之差，imported为进口形容词。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: limit actually constrains result定义binding有约束力。marginal边际、clearing出清不表示政策确实限制，其他义不合。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: allocating restricted availability定义rationing配给。incidence负担归属非数量分配办法，subsidy补助不命名限量分货机制。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: relative responsiveness定义elasticity弹性。marginal为边际形容词，incidence分配负担不度量相对反应，其他不合。

questions.prompt: The Price Where Plans Met: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: distribution tax burden定义incidence税负归宿。welfare福利变化较广，subsidy补贴不是税负归属，其他不合。

units.title: 六级选词：会话修复中的发起与完成
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Who Asked for the Clarification?
materials.text:
A fictional conversation-analysis class examined a fully transcribed exchange. One participant mentioned a place; another asked which place was meant; the first then supplied a fuller description. The analysis called this process ____1____, the participants’ work on a problem of speaking, hearing or understanding. It was broader than replacing a factually wrong word with a correct one.

The possible source of the problem was called ____2____. The request for clarification performed ____3____, making that difficulty relevant for further action. The later fuller description contributed to its ____4____, the point at which the practical work of resolving the difficulty was accomplished in this exchange. Starting a process and accomplishing it were therefore separate events.

A ____5____ was an opportunity or stretch of contribution within the exchange. The person producing the current contribution was its ____6____; the person it addressed was its ____7____. These roles could change as the exchange developed. They were not permanent properties attached to the two people before any conversation began.

The written ____8____ used conventions to represent timing and speech. Where two contributions occurred together, the record marked ____9____. This temporal relationship did not automatically establish hostility or an attempt to seize the floor. Its role had to be examined in the unfolding interaction.

The next relevant response provided evidence of ____10____, how an earlier contribution had been understood and taken forward. The analyst did not claim direct access to everything a participant privately thought. The method connected an interpretation with visible interactional evidence. The class also kept an analyst’s explanatory label distinct from a word the participants themselves had used, so technical vocabulary did not silently become a quotation from the conversation.

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: work speaking hearing understanding trouble定义repair修复。correction只是纠错较窄且首段否认等同，sequence一般次序非此特定过程。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: source possible problem定义trouble麻烦源。silence沉默可时征但不命名所有问题源，preference组织倾向不合。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: clarification makes difficulty relevant starts定义initiation发起。completion完成下一句对照，correction改正不等问哪地。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: resolution accomplished point定义completion完成。initiation仅启动，uptake理解后反应不直接命名修复完成节点。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: opportunity/stretch contribution定义turn话轮。sequence含多个相关行动非单个发言机会，adjacency邻接关系非发言段本身。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: producing current contribution定义speaker说话者。recipient接收者对照，other过程名不命名产出人。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: person addressed定义recipient受话者。speaker当前发话者不同，其他候选无对人称。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: written record conventions timing speech定义transcript转写。sequence互动序列非书面记录本身，adjacency关系不指文档。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: contributions same time定义overlap重叠。silence无语音与同时发言相反，correction内容纠正非时间并发。

questions.prompt: Who Asked for the Clarification?: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: how prior contribution understood taken forward定义uptake承接理解。preference结构倾向、adjacency相邻关系均不命名此后续理解证据。

units.title: 六级选词：用水核算中的取水、耗水与地点
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Two Products and One Water Total
materials.text:
A fictional assessment compared water use in two production systems. Its accounting ____1____ specified which stages and locations were included. An apparently precise total could still describe a limited part of the activity. The report therefore made the scope available before comparing the figures.

____2____ meant taking water from a stated body or supply. ____3____ referred to the portion not returned to the same relevant water system within the accounting conditions. The two quantities were not automatically identical. Water returned through a ____4____ could differ in location or quality from the incoming water, so a simple returned-versus-not-returned distinction did not answer every environmental question.

The ____5____ recorded the amount of water in physical units. This quantity alone did not establish the local consequence. An equal amount taken from two places could have different significance where competing needs and available resources differed. The report therefore examined ____6____, the pressure arising when available water was insufficient relative to relevant demands under its chosen definition.

Timing mattered as well. A ____7____ pattern varied with the time of year. Annual aggregation could conceal a period when local demands and availability had a different relationship. The analysts retained that timing rather than treating the yearly total as proof of uniform conditions in every month.

Water-use ____8____ expressed an amount per unit of output. The ____9____ named the output quantity underneath that ratio. A lower ratio did not necessarily imply a lower total if production expanded enough.

Where several products shared a process, ____10____ concerned how common burdens were assigned among them. The choice was stated and justified, not hidden behind one number. The exercise demonstrated how scope, place, time and accounting conventions shaped an interpretation; it did not certify either fictional product as environmentally preferable in every respect.

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: which stages locations included定义boundary边界。source来源仅一项非系统所含范围，allocation为共享负担划分非阶段界。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: taking from stated body supply定义withdrawal取水。consumption耗水特指未归部分，storage存储不必从水体提取。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: not returned same relevant system defines consumption耗水。withdrawal最初总提取非未归，evaporation可机制但不等所有耗水概念。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: returned through a discharge排放。source源头非返回排口事件，storage储存不表回排，其他不合。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: amount physical water units定义volume体积。intensity比率非总物理量，denominator分母角色不是水量本身名称。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: insufficient water relative demands定义scarcity稀缺。storage存量、source来源不命名供需不足关系，其他不合。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: varied time year定义seasonal季节性的。weighted加权、recycled回用不表年内季节变化，其他词词性不合。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: amount per output定义intensity强度。volume只是量非比，denominator分母为比的一部分，其他义不合。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: output underneath ratio定义denominator分母。source来源、volume体积若也可单位但不命名underneath比例角色。

questions.prompt: Two Products and One Water Total: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: common burden assigned products定义allocation分配。storage水存储、consumption耗水总额不是多产品分摊规则。

units.title: 六级选词：分类指标中的阈值与群体比较
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: One Threshold and Several Error Rates
materials.text:
A fictional methods workshop examined a classifier used in a limited demonstration. The model produced a ____1____, a numerical indication of its assessment. A ____2____ converted that number into a categorical decision: values on one side received the positive category under the stated rule. Changing that cutoff could alter several error rates at once.

The dataset also contained a recorded ____3____ for each example, the category treated as the reference answer. The workshop asked how those references had been obtained. Treating a field as ground truth for a calculation did not prove that its collection process was free from error or represented every goal of the institution.

____4____ was the proportion of predicted positives that were positive under that reference. ____5____ was the proportion of reference positives that the classifier identified. Their different ____6____, the quantities underneath the two ratios, explained why the measures could move differently. Reporting one without its conditioning group could obscure the question it answered.

The ____7____ of the positive category described how common it was within the relevant population. A change in that rate could affect some predictive measures even when other properties remained fixed. The example did not infer an identical population from an identical model name.

____8____ concerned whether stated probability levels corresponded to observed frequencies under the specified comparison. A score could be useful for ranking without automatically satisfying that separate property.

The analysts described a measured ____9____ between groups, a difference requiring interpretation rather than an instant explanation of its cause. They also examined selection-rate ____10____, equality of positive-decision proportions under the defined comparison. That criterion was not presented as the only possible social objective. The case required a choice of goals and evidence about consequences before a numerical comparison could support a broader judgement.

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: numerical model assessment defines score分值。label类别非数值评估，threshold截止规则下一空不同。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: cutoff number to category定义threshold阈值。score评估值非截断点，counterfactual反事实不指决策切点。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: reference category recorded定义label标签。accuracy整套正确比例非每例类别，utility效用评价不是参考答案字段。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: predicted positives that reference positive定义precision精确率。recall条件在参考阳性，accuracy所有样本正确率不同。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: reference positives identified定义recall召回率。precision条件在预测阳性，prevalence人群阳性总率非识出比例。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: quantities underneath ratios定义denominator分母。score数值、threshold截点不命名比率基数角色，其他不合。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: how common positive in population定义prevalence流行率/基率。accuracy预测正确率、precision预测阳性正确率条件不同。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: probability levels match observed frequencies定义calibration校准。accuracy分类正确不保证概率校准，utility效用不指频率匹配。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: difference groups定义disparity差异。parity相等相反，counterfactual未发生比较不是已量差异本身。

questions.prompt: One Threshold and Several Error Rates: choose the unchanged word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: equality selection proportions定义parity平等。equalised是分词且selection-rate equalised不成此名词短语，disparity差异与equality反。
